Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

The October 24 wrap compares strong AI-linked equipment demand with weak housing and managed care. It discusses Tesla expectations, credit-score competition and efficient scale businesses, while directing viewers to bank earnings supplements.

The operating contrast is useful and supported by several issuer releases. GE Vernova orders are confused with backlog, and the FHFA policy is incorrectly described as requiring both FICO and VantageScore. Strong company results are kept separate from investment-return forecasts.

### 001. Strong iPhone demand helps Apple, but the stock still needs a clearer AI narrative.

<a id="youtube-LxRiEMZ9NYI-c002"></a>
### 002. AI-linked industrial demand is strong while the rest of the economy is more mixed.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 1:50-2:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxRiEMZ9NYI&t=110s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

GE Vernova and Amphenol strong results contrast with Pulte and Molina weakness. This supports dispersion, not the claim that literally all GDP growth comes from AI.

Assessment test: Compare broad sector evidence rather than infer national growth from a few firms.

- [GE Vernova Q3 2025 results](https://www.gevernova.com/sites/default/files/gev_webcast_pressrelease_10222025.pdf) (2025-10-22): Quarterly orders were $14.6 billion, up 55% organically, and revenue was $10 billion. Gas equipment backlog and slot reservations rose to 62 GW. Quarterly orders are not the full backlog.
- [Amphenol Q3 2025 results](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2025/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Third-Quarter-2025-Results-and-Announces-Dividend-Increase/default.aspx) (2025-10-22): Sales grew 53%, 41% organically, with exceptional IT datacom growth. Adjusted EPS rose 86%; organic and acquired growth must be separated.
- [PulteGroup Q3 2025 results](https://www.pultegroup.com/investor-relations/news/news-details/2025/PulteGroup-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results/default.aspx) (2025-10-21): EPS fell to $2.96 from $3.35 and net new orders were 6,638 homes. The release supports the contemporary weak-housing diagnosis.
- [Molina Q3 2025 results](https://investors.molinahealthcare.com/news-releases/news-release-details/molina-healthcare-reports-third-quarter-2025-financial-results) (2025-10-22): Adjusted EPS was $1.84 and 2025 guidance fell to about $14. A preliminary 2026 outlook approximated that lowered level, pending formal guidance.

<a id="youtube-LxRiEMZ9NYI-c009"></a>
### 009. Tesla valuation relies on future businesses rather than current auto profits.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 7:36-8:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxRiEMZ9NYI&t=456s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

A very high price-to-current-earnings ratio requires materially different future cash flows or a different required return to be justified. The exact quoted multiples are not independently verified here.

Conditional reasoning: Capitalizing an unchanged small earnings stream at a normal discount rate cannot justify an arbitrarily large price; justification must rely on growth, new cash flows or unusually low required returns.

Assessment test: Value the auto business and optional future businesses separately.

<a id="youtube-LxRiEMZ9NYI-c013"></a>
### 013. FHFA now requires mortgage lenders to use VantageScore alongside FICO.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 11:28-11:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxRiEMZ9NYI&t=688s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The interim policy allowed either Classic FICO or VantageScore 4.0, not a universal requirement to buy both.

Assessment test: Read the operative lender-choice policy and effective implementation.

- [Credit-score transition policy](https://www.fhfa.gov/credit-scores) (2026-10-02): The July 8, 2025 interim policy permitted lenders to choose either Classic FICO or VantageScore 4.0. It did not require every lender to use both scores.

## Framework and tools

- Follow order conversion in long-cycle equipment.
- Compare organic and acquired growth.
- Separate valuation expectations from current operations.
- Learn the actual regulatory rule before extrapolating competition.

Tools and charts discussed, not a complete visual inspection:

- Orders versus backlog
- Organic sales growth
- Home closings and new orders
- Medical cost ratios
- Credit-score rules
- Earnings supplements
